title: feat(master-detail): live Subtotal / Tax / Total stack
body:
## Why

The last P1 item for the line-item editor: the right-aligned **Subtotal / Tax / Total** block every invoicing tool shows, computed live during entry.

## What

`MasterDetailForm` renders a document totals stack under the line items when the parent form has a tax-rate field (`taxRateField`, default `tax_rate`):

- **Subtotal** = Σ line amounts
- **Tax** = Subtotal × header rate %
- **Total** = Subtotal + Tax

The header rate is read **live** via scoped event delegation on the existing form host (`formHostRef`) — no coupling into `ObjectForm`/`FormSchema` internals. When the stack is shown, the per-grid footer total is subsumed. The stack only appears when the tax-rate field is present, so other master-detail forms (e.g. project + tasks) are unaffected.

## Verification

- Unit: `MasterDetailForm` tests pass.
- Live e2e: New Invoice → pick Widget A, Qty 2, Tax Rate 10 → **Subtotal ¥59.98 / Tax (10%) ¥6.00 / Total ¥65.98**.
- Browser-verified (Gadget X × 2 @ 99 + 10% → ¥217.80).

> Pairs with framework#1640 (the `showcase_invoice.tax_rate` field). The live backend already serves it.
